svg.title: Edge Split
svg.desc: Edge Split Geometric Extraction & Intersection This tool automatically scans the 3D model (or specific selected parts) to extract all solid edges. It brings them into a global coordinate system and splits the intersecting lines based on a user-defined tolerance threshold. Automated Cleanup: Generates a clean object with the split edges and automatically hides the original solid bodies to keep the workspace clear. Assembly Aware: Respects the global position of parts nested inside complex assemblies or linked objects.
